newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen SEG passes B share,dividend plans.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen SEG passes B share,dividend plans.

text.p: Shenzhen SEG Co Ltd's shareholders have agreed to issue 50 million additional B shares and make a three-for-10 bonus issue, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
The television tube maker would use proceeds to fund business expansion, the statement in Tuesday's Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
The share issue, which requires final approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, will be priced nearer to the offer date based on market conditions, it said.
SEG plans to issue the B shares after distributing the dividend, it said without giving more details.
Company officials were not immediate available for comment.
Trading in the company's shares was suspended on Wednesday for the meeting and will resume on Thursday afternoon, the Shenzhen stock exchange has said.
SEG's net profits soared to 127.22 million yuan in 1996 from 100.05 million the year before based on international accounting standards, it had said.
